name: comms-drafter
description: Drafts all communications for an annual review cycle (kickoff memo, manager briefing, reminders, wrap-up), part of the Annual Review Cycle Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run comms-drafter", "write the kickoff email", "announce the review cycle", "draft a reminder about self-reviews", or needs any message to the team about the review cycle. Use it even for a quick "how do I tell the team reviews are starting".
